title: Multifidelity Operator Inference for Dynamical Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.17503v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper presents a multifidelity (MF) formulation of Operator Inference (OpInf) for learning non-intrusive, physics-based reduced-order models (ROMs) of nonlinear dynamical systems. OpInf learns reduced operators from projections of snapshot data by solving a least squares regression problem. However, generating high-fidelity snapshots can be computationally expensive, limiting parameter coverage and the temporal extent of training trajectories for many aerospace applications, which can lead to inaccurate or unstable ROM predictions. This work proposes MF-OpInf, which combines limited high-fidelity snapshots with more plentiful low-fidelity snapshots through a control-variates-inspired MF least squares formulation to learn a single set of reduced operators across multiple trajectories. translated_title: 面向动力系统的多保真度算子推断方法
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种多保真度的算子推断方法，用于学习非线性动力系统的非侵入式、基于物理的降阶模型。OpInf通过求解最小二乘回归问题，从快照数据的投影中学习降阶算子。然而，生成高保真度快照的计算成本可能非常昂贵，这限制了许多航空航天应用中的参数覆盖范围以及训练轨迹的时间跨度，从而可能导致降阶模型预测不准确或不稳定。本工作提出了MF-OpInf方法，通过一种受控制变量法启发的多保真度最小二乘公式，将有限的高保真度快照与更丰富的低保真度快照相结合，以在多条轨迹上学习单一的一组降阶算子。低保真度轨迹提供了额外的参数覆盖范围，并延伸超出高保真度训练的时间范围。
tldr: 本文提出MF-OpInf方法，通过受控制变量法启发的多保真度最小二乘公式，将有限的高保真度快照与丰富的低保真度快照相结合，为非线性动力系统学习更准确稳定的非侵入式降阶模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MF-OpInf, which combines limited high-fidelity snapshots with plentiful low-fidelity snapshots through a control-variates-inspired multifidelity least squares formulation to learn accurate and stable non-intrusive reduced-order models for nonlinear dynamical systems.
